title: What to say if your body doesn't cooperate

series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 3 of 7

beats.vo: If your body stops cooperating your first time, you only need one sentence.
"My body's not cooperating right now." That's it.

visual.text: My body's not cooperating right now.

beats.vo: Don't apologize five times. Repeated apologies make it more awkward than the thing itself.
Stay close, put your attention on her, and take your time.
beats.visual_intent: Fireplace close-up, warm glow, no people.

beats.vo: This happens to way more guys than you'd think.
beats.visual_intent: Apartment building windows lit at night, many windows.

beats.vo: Number two is next: why going slow is the most underrated move you've got.
